subject.title: feat(ui): clickable file links in chat with a workspace file viewer sidebar

question: Should `sessions.files.get` remain under `operator.read` while expanding from transcript-touched files to any fs-safe in-workspace file for the Control UI viewer?
rationale: The implementation keeps containment and preview guards, but the authorization contract changes from session-referenced file reads to arbitrary in-root workspace file contents, which automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded in-root reads
options.body: Keep the current product direction and merge after maintainer/security review confirms `operator.read` intentionally covers these workspace file contents.

options.title: Split the read-scope change
options.body: Land chat file-link rendering and transcript-touched previews first, then decide workspace-wide content preview in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Keep transcript-only reads
options.body: Reject the workspace-wide content read and retain browser copy/browse behavior until a different authorization or protocol shape exists.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded in-root reads
recommendation.body: Keep the current product direction and merge after maintainer/security review confirms `operator.read` intentionally covers these workspace file contents.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current PR and canonical issue and have the strongest recent adjacent history on the UI and Gateway workspace browsing direction.
